d01-passport.observed_description: A closed dark-red passport with a small gold circle emblem lies on a light wooden table beside a white cup.
d01-passport.note: Usable: reads as a passport at 180 px; no letters or numbers.

d02-suitcase.observed_description: A dark-blue hard rolling suitcase with its handle up stands alone on a wooden hallway floor in front of a white front door.
d02-suitcase.note: Usable: a suitcase at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop.

d03-backpack.observed_description: Diego in his burgundy shirt stands in a bright hallway holding a grey backpack in front of him by its top strap, smiling at the camera.
d03-backpack.note: Usable: Diego with a backpack reads at 180 px (he holds it rather than wears it, so its sentences say he has a backpack).

d04-dont-forget.observed_description: In a hallway by an open front door Ana, holding a dark-blue rolling suitcase, reaches for a dark-red passport that a grey-haired woman in a light-blue cardigan holds out to her.
d04-dont-forget.note: Usable: handing Ana her passport before she leaves reads at 360 px; the passport is between their hands.
